environment: Local Linux; accelerated real authenticated loopback HTTP. No EC2 capacity claim.
methodology: Full scenarios, one execution at a time. Processing excludes pacing; CPU/RSS include setup, validation, serialization and forced GC. Logical hashes exclude timings. Historical Legacy evidence is retained separately; no Legacy runtime.

historical_radial_reference.interpretation: 80/80 evacuados en ambos casos por evacuación preventiva temprana;69 cierres máximos radiales frente a14 físicos. Índice anterior y profundidad nueva no son magnitudes comparables. Configuraciones y tiempos físicos distintos impiden inferir precisión o mejora de supervivencia.

browser.client_work_method: Chromium CDP counters during master start/pause workflow: main-thread work, script, layout and style separately from HTTP wait. Not paint FPS or a per-frame latency claim.

zombie_http.methodology: real loopback HTTP /paso; initial unchanged observable snapshot; one warmup per active survivor; latency includes transport and decoding; nearest-rank percentiles; full scenarios measure invalidation separately
zombie_http.scenario: Ronda 3 — Apocalipsis — aparición urbana por zonas

limitations: Synthetic terrain, experimental shoreline and drainage; no conditioned real DEM or observed flood calibration
Local timings from shared workstation, not EC2 capacity or Safari evidence
Android APK compiled; no physical-device installation verified

visualization_browser.checks: Real React/Go zombie BASE + flood FULL_MANTA; explicit start, SVG atlases, LOD, opt-out, pause/resume, offline, reduced motion, reload, completion; desktop/mobile screenshots and measured RAF/DOM/heap
visualization_browser.note: Intervals between Chromium RAF callbacks, not paint FPS; real HTTP and actual SVG. No Safari claim.
